scope: Experimental M0 only; no public API or production modification

environment.os: Windows local development machine; not production VM

matrix.method: one worker per case; cold first build; ten additional builds, discard two, median/p95 of eight; app caches only, OS cache not purged

concurrency.method: Independent M0 harness, shared priority queue and in-flight deduplication; no scene-server code modified; foreground jobs outrank queued prewarm jobs; active prewarm jobs are not interrupted

engineLifecycle.method: One M0 worker, shared sequential budget; one builder per visited dimension retained (bounded at three); GC at equal End checkpoints; real snapshot End is empty
One M0 worker, shared sequential budget; one builder per visited dimension retained (bounded at three); GC at equal End checkpoints; real snapshot End is empty

recommendations.surfaceCache: separate protected partition; existing snapshot cleanup retained
recommendations.publicAccess: all users; deployment policy and public throttling are out of scope

limitations: p95 uses eight post-warm-up measurements per matrix case; descriptive sample, not production SLA
World has no End chunks; End lifecycle data comes from generated catalog
Prototype retains column-based tint sampling; full 3D cave-biome tinting remains Milestone 1
Concurrency/cache tests are an independent local simulation, not the scene server
Browser private bytes include browser/driver/OS caches, are not equal to JS heap or live GPU bytes
Object disposal, retained water-depth node and bounded mesh reuse are experimental harness changes, not applied to shipped viewer
